source: Zerihan, J. & Zhang, X. (2000). Aerodynamics of a single element wing in ground effect. J. Aircraft 37(6):1058-1064. doi:10.2514/2.2711
verified: 2026-09-12, text extracted from a public mirror of the paper; values read from Fig. 3a are approximate (~)
wing: Tyrrell 026 F1 front-wing main element (derived from NASA GA(W) LS(1)-0413), chord 223.4 mm, span 1100 mm, endplates
ride_height_definition: distance from ground to the lowest point on the wing at zero incidence
CL_sign: positive = downforce in the paper; equals -Cl in this project
